4e4061a12c1eab62.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.  

The customers you'll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they're trying to solve are real and urgent. You'll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.  

The Role

We're looking for an Escalation Engineer to join the Cockroach Labs Technical Support team in the AMER region. You will be the escalation point for the most challenging customer issues: reviewing, assisting with, or taking over cases that need more expertise or oversight, and driving resolution with other departments. You are expected to work with a high level of autonomy and resolve complex issues quickly.

This is a remote role open to candidates in the Pacific or Mountain time zone, as the team operates in Pacific time zone hours.

You Will

• Provide advanced support to customers and front-line technical support engineers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues via CRM, Slack, video chat, and/or remote access.

• Act as a point of escalation for tickets with no clear path to resolution where the Technical Support team has exhausted available tools and processes.

• Identify when a ticket or account requires additional support and act proactively to course correct.

• Use AI-assisted tooling in your investigations, including log and debug-bundle analysis, reproduction scaffolding, and code reading, and verify its output before it reaches a customer or an engineer.

• Evaluate how escalations could have been avoided, and contribute to process, tooling, and observability improvements that reduce escalations and time to resolution, including where AI tooling could help.

• Provide training and mentorship to junior support staff, sharing knowledge and expertise to help them handle complex issues more effectively.

• Share effective AI workflows with the team, and help front-line engineers learn where AI output is reliable and where it needs independent verification.

• Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of ongoing cases, including steps taken, findings, and proposed solutions.

• Advocate for the customer within the organization, ensuring that their concerns are understood and addressed appropriately.

• Participate in on-call and shift rotations with transfer of cases to other geographic regions in a “follow the sun” methodology.

• Stay updated on new features, technologies, and best practices related to the products or services supported.

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you'll learn CockroachDB, our customers, and our company through a self-guided onboarding platform of reading and hands-on exercises. By the end of the month, you'll be assisting customers directly.

After 3 months, you'll be fully integrated into the team and will be familiar with the various systems we use. You'll be able to manage most issues from customers and will be able to contribute to improving the scope and quality of our offerings. As our team and your expertise grow, you’ll begin mentoring and training new members of the team, developing and updating training and documentation to ensure that knowledge is not lost.

You Have

• 7+ years of experience working in Technical Support or a similar technical role at a software company.

• Strong knowledge of databases and the ability to read and write SQL.

• Knowledge of distributed systems, Linux, and an understanding of software development.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, including root cause analysis, in a global 24x7x365 environment.

• Experience using AI tools to troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues, an understanding of their common failure modes, and the judgment to verify their output before relying on it.

• A customer-first approach to critical thinking.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including adjusting tone and content for technical and non-technical audiences, and a passion for working with users directly.

• The polish expected when working with Fortune 500 enterprise customers.

• Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, the technologies behind enterprise applications.

• The ability to absorb information. You love getting into the weeds technically, but don't let that distract you from achieving your goals.

• The ability to participate in a weekend on-call rotation.

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

Benefits

• Stock Options

• Medical Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Life and Disability Insurance

• Professional Development Funds

• Flexible Time Off

• Paid Holidays

• Paid Sick Days

• Paid Parental Leave

• Retirement Benefits

• Mental Wellbeing Benefits

• And more!

The annual anticipated base salary range for candidates for this role is listed below. Salary is one component of the Cockroach Labs’ Total Rewards package, which also includes: stock options, medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, life and disability insurance, funds for professional development, flexible paid time off, paid sick days and holidays, paid parental leave, and wellbeing benefits. We have a match on 401(k) contributions in the U.S. 

We set competitive pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Benefits programs are designed according to local market practices. Actual salaries may vary and fall outside of this range depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, and competencies. In addition, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.
Annual Anticipated Base Salary Range
$130,000—$180,000 USD

• Own the commercial relationship: Serve as the primary executive point of contact across the C-suite—CEO, CFO, CSCO, COO, CIO—building relationships that transcend any individual deal cycle and anchor Celonis to the customer’s long-term strategic agenda.

• Scale the practice: Codify account strategies, expansion motions, and transformation navigation approaches into reusable assets for the broader Strategic Accounts practice. The qualifications you need

• 12+ years in enterprise SaaS sales or strategic account management, with at least 5 years managing accounts with $5M+ ARR.

• Deep industry expertise in Financial Services— with the credibility to engage customers on industry-specific challenges, benchmarks, and transformation priorities, not just platform capabilities.

• Preferred direct experience with large financial institutions leading transformation initiatives or acting as a strategic consultant or Client Director.

• Demonstrated track record of growing ARR within named accounts over multi-year horizons—expanding platform footprint, not just renewing contracts.

• Executive presence and credibility at the C-suite level—able to lead strategic conversations with CFOs, COOs, and CIOs and influence large, complex buying decisions.

• Experience navigating enterprise transformations—ERP consolidations, cloud migrations, M&A, organizational restructuring—without losing commercial momentum.

• Fluent in business case construction: ROI modeling, TCO analysis, and value benchmarking at a level that withstands CFO scrutiny.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Elastic IT team is moving beyond simple chat to the next frontier: Agentic Workflows and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Systems. We are looking for an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to join our team. You will build multi-agent ecosystems that are self-directed. These ecosystems will do more than just answer questions. They will collaborate, delegate tasks, and execute complex business processes across the organization.

In this role, you will focus on large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration, and A2A integration frameworks to power our intelligent workforce. You will create workflows for multiple agents instead of just focusing on single-agent search or managing the stack. These workflows will enable the agents to communicate with each other, share information, access enterprise tools, and automate tasks from start to finish. Driven by a service-oriented mindset, you will empower internal teams with cutting-edge LLM capabilities while integrating seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Are you ready to build the next generation of LLM-powered multi-agent systems that supercharge enterprise productivity? Join us to enable agent-to-agent workflows that turn collective knowledge into instant, coordinated action across Elastic.

What You Will Be Doing

  • A2A Architecture & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Design, build, and deploy agent-to-agent (A2A) communication architectures and workflows that enable autonomous agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, and negotiate multi-step business processes.
  • LLM Integration & Tool Calling: Integrate advanced LLMs, both proprietary and open-source, with enterprise APIs. Use tool-calling methods. Connect with third-party SaaS applications for smooth operations.
  • Enterprise Grounding & RAG: Use advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Implement strategies that connect enterprise context by using search and vector storage engines. This will ensure that all inter-agent operations are highly accurate and reliable.
  • Scalable Infrastructure & IaC: Provision and manage robust cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Terraform to support the high-concurrency demands of LLM inferences and multi-agent coordination.

LightFury Games is building E-Cricket a mobile-first, AAA cricket game built on Unreal Engine 5, with the ambition to create a deeply engaging cricket experience for players globally.

Were looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager / Principal Product Manager who can take ownership of major product areas and work closely with Game Design, Engineering, UX, Art, Analytics, and Leadership to turn player needs and business goals into a great game experience.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys solving complex product problems, working closely with game teams, and building products where player experience, engagement, and business outcomes all matter.

What Youll Own

Own product strategy and roadmap for key areas of E-Cricket.Translate player needs, business objectives, and game vision into clear product priorities.Work closely with Game Design, Engineering, UX, Art, Analytics, and other teams to drive features from concept to launch.Define product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and acceptance criteria.Use player behaviour, product analytics, research, and feedback to identify opportunities and improve the experience.Drive prioritisation across competing product, technical, and business requirements.Partner with game designers and engineers to ensure features are both compelling for players and technically viable.Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, progression, monetisation, and overall player experience.Establish and track meaningful product KPIs and use data to drive decisions.Take ownership of product experiments, iteration, and continuous improvement.Communicate product vision, priorities, and trade-offs clearly across teams and leadership.Help build scalable product processes as the game and organisation grow.

What Were Looking For

8+ years of product management experience, with strong experience owning consumer-facing digital products.Experience working on games, gaming platforms, entertainment products, consumer apps, or other highly engaging products is strongly preferred.Strong understanding of player/user behaviour, engagement, retention, progression, and monetisation.Proven experience taking products/features from 01 and/or scaling existing products.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into product decisions.Excellent understanding of product discovery, prioritisation, experimentation, and roadmap planning.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to work effectively with highly cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly.Strong ownership mindset you identify problems, build alignment, and drive them through to execution.

For Principal Product Manager

For the Principal level, were looking for someone who can operate beyond an individual product area and help shape product strategy, systems, and direction across the broader game.

You Should Be Comfortable

Defining product strategy across multiple interconnected areas.Driving complex, cross-functional initiatives.Mentoring and influencing other Product Managers.Establishing product frameworks, metrics, and decision-making processes.Working directly with senior leadership on major product and business decisions.Balancing long-term product vision with immediate execution priorities.

Why LightFury 

At LightFury, you wont just be managing a roadmap youll be helping build a game from the ground up.

Youll have the opportunity to work with a global team building an ambitious AAA cricket experience on Unreal Engine 5, with meaningful ownership over the product and the player experience.

If youre excited by the idea of building something ambitious in gaming and want to have a direct impact on what millions of players could eventually experience, wed love to hear from you.
